\begingroup\scriptsize
The following are compiler/driver statistics for compute kernels recorded during rendering. Scene construction and pixel packing are excluded. Register counts and spills retain the driver's native units; they must not be compared across vendors as equivalent register files. Subgroups per SIMD is a static residency limit, not measured achieved occupancy. A maximum row is the independent maximum of one metric over the rendering kernels; it does not describe a single combined kernel.\\
\noindent\textbf{Register allocation summary}\par
Each GPU/driver/host combination has its own column. Counts retain the driver's native register-file names and units; SGPRs, VGPRs and GRFs are not added together. Repeated runs are reduced by taking the maximum for each cell. A dash means a metric was not reported; N/A means no standalone kernel exists. Subgroup widths and native metric definitions are listed in the detailed tables.\\
